info.title: Machina API
info.description: REST API for Linux hypervisor hosts: QEMU/KVM domains via libvirt, networks, storage, host networking, backups, metrics, optional OpenStack Nova/Glance/Neutron management, and optional KubeVirt bundle/apply workflows when configured.

error_code.description: Stable code: not_found, invalid_request, forbidden, libvirt_connection, operation_failed, internal_error, unauthorized

upload_size_gi.description: DataVolume PVC size (Gi) for upload and manifests

cluster_exec_enabled.description: True when [kubevirt] exec_enabled — POST kubevirt/* may run kubectl/virtctl on the daemon host

KubeVirtBundleRequest.description: Optional overrides for bundle generation (same fields as GET kubevirt-bundle query).

VirtImageBuildRequest.description: Build a disk with virt-builder on the daemon (virt-image-build). Requires [libvirt] virt_builder_allowed. Output parent must be under libvirt pool targets or default image dirs; file must not exist.

output.description: Absolute path for the new image

firstboot_script.description: Host path to script copied into guest firstboot

timeout_secs.description: Kill virt-builder after this many seconds (0 = unlimited; daemon may set from [libvirt] virt_image_build_timeout_secs)

GuacamoleAuthResponse.description: Encrypted JSON blob for Apache Guacamole /api/tokens (requires [guacamole] in daemon config)

guac_data.description: POST as form field data to Guacamole /api/tokens

token.description: Optional Guacamole auth token when fetch_token succeeds

cloud_init_iso.description: Optional second CD-ROM (cloud-init seed); install ISO uses `iso`

create_backend.description: Omit or empty for server default (virt_install unless configured otherwise); libvirt_xml or virt_install to override.

virt_builder_os.description: Legacy libguestfs virt-builder template (virt-builder --list). Disabled by default on the server ([libvirt] virt_builder_allowed). Prefer mkosi_workspace for new deployments.

virt_builder_hostname.description: Guest hostname for virt-builder (optional; derived from VM name if empty).

virt_builder_ssh_pubkey.description: Single-line OpenSSH public key for root SSH inject (optional if root password file or server default pubkey path is set).

virt_builder_root_password_file.description: Absolute path on the daemon host to a small file (≤4KiB) with guest root password; virt-builder uses --root-password file:… (not password: on argv).

mkosi_workspace.description: Preferred: absolute path to directory containing mkosi.conf; run `mkosi build` and use newest .raw/.qcow2 artifact as root disk. Mutually exclusive with virt_builder_os.

mkosi_image.description: For multi-image mkosi workspaces (image trees): select a specific image via `mkosi --image <name>`. Leave empty to build the workspace normally.

virt_install_define_only.description: virt-install --print-xml=1 then virDomainDefineXML: define a halted VM without install media (Cockpit-style create without starting).

virt_install_location.description: virt-install --location (HTTP(S) tree, NFS, or directory) for network kickstart / OS install.

virt_install_pxe.description: virt-install --pxe with an extra --network for PXE boot.

virt_install_pxe_network.description: Libvirt network name for the PXE interface (defaults to `network` when empty).

virt_install_disk_backing_store.description: Absolute path to backing qcow2/raw for a new overlay disk; virt-install uses size=disk_gb,format=qcow2,backing_store=… and --import.

HostFilesystem.description: One mount from df -B1 -T (virtual fstypes omitted)

signal.description: Echo of requested signal keyword (TERM or KILL)

PackageActionResult.description: Stdout/stderr from a mutating package-manager run on the host

dry_run.description: When true, runs a distro-specific upgrade simulation (no system changes) instead of applying upgrades

guest.description: Script profile id for build-linux-image.sh (e.g. ubuntu2404, fedora43)

get.summary: List recent background jobs (virt-image-build, Golden Forge / Packer, VM create with logs)

200.description: Newest-first job summaries (in-memory; cleared on daemon restart)

post.summary: Start virt-image-build asynchronously (returns job id; use GET /jobs/{id} or stream)
Start Golden Forge (local Packer/QEMU golden qcow2) asynchronously
post.description: Runs `bash /usr/local/share/machina/packer/build-linux-image.sh <guest> work` under `/var/lib/machina/packer-builds/<job-id>`. Requires the script installed (e.g. via install.sh). Returns job id; use GET /jobs/{id} or GET /jobs/{id}/stream for logs.

get.summary: Job detail with captured log lines
SSE: log chunks (data events), then complete or error

post.summary: Create VM with live SSE logs (mkosi / virt-builder / virt-install / qemu-img)
post.description: Long-running HTTP response. Put reverse proxies in front with a generous read/send timeout (e.g. hours) or mkosi builds may be cut off. The first event is `event: job` with JSON `{"id":"<uuid>"}` so clients can open GET /jobs/{id} while the stream continues.

200.description: text/event-stream; default events are log lines, then `event: complete` with JSON or `event: error`

get.summary: KubeVirt migration bundle (CDI upload DV + VM YAML, virtio root + virtio-win CDROM)
get.description: Derives the root disk from libvirt domain XML, emits a CDI DataVolume (upload) and kubevirt.io VirtualMachine with virtio disks. virtio-win is attached as containerDisk (cluster image; configure [kubevirt] virtio_container_disk_image). Query: namespace, k8s_vm_name, datavolume_name, storage_gi, storage_class, include_virtio_cdrom (default true).

post.description: Writes the same YAML as GET kubevirt-bundle to a temp file and runs kubectl apply -f. Requires [kubevirt] exec_enabled = true and kubectl on the daemon host. Body: optional KubeVirtBundleRequest overrides.

post.summary: virtctl image-upload for root disk → DataVolume
post.description: Runs virtctl image-upload against the libvirt root disk path from domain XML. Long-running. Requires exec_enabled and CDI upload DV already applied (or compatible cluster state).

post.summary: virtctl start for generated KubeVirt VM
post.description: Runs virtctl start for virtual_machine_name in namespace from the bundle. Requires exec_enabled.

get.description: Returns VNC target + signed/encrypted `guac_data` for Apache Guacamole JSON auth. Disabled unless [guacamole] enabled=true and json_secret_hex set.
